title: Taking Steps Toward the Pose: Numerical Inverse Kinematics, the Damping That Keeps It Going Near a Singularity, and Knowing When It Has Failed

artifact.note: a numerical inverse kinematics solver for the three link arm: the Jacobian, a damped least squares step that is limited in size, joint limits applied at every step, and a result that says whether it got there and how close it was if it did not
